title: Chipping Machining (Gia công cắt gọt có phoi)

equipment_and_parts.def: A power-driven machine used for cutting or shaping metal.
Machine that rotates a workpiece against a cutting tool to shape cylindrical parts.
Machine that uses a rotating multi-tooth cutter to remove metal from a fixed workpiece.
Machine fitted with a drill bit to cut circular holes.
Machine using an abrasive wheel for surface finishing and high precision.
Machine using a toothed blade or abrasive disc to cut material to length.
Contains the drive motor, gears, and spindle of a lathe.
Supports long workpieces and holds tools like center drills and reamers.
Rotating shaft that drives the chuck and workpiece (lathe) or cutter (mill).
Clamping device on the spindle that holds the workpiece firmly.
Mount on the carriage that holds the cutting tool securely.
Moves longitudinally along the lathe bed to feed the tool.
Heavy foundation providing precision guideways for carriage and tailstock.
Allows tool movement perpendicular to the lathe bed for facing and depth of cut.
Precision threaded screw used for thread cutting feeds.
Drives power carriage feeds during standard turning operations.
Rotating cutting tool with flutes to make holes.
Thin sharp piece of metal with teeth used for sawing.
Wheel made of bonded abrasive grains used in grinders.
